title: Duties and Privileges of the Leader of the Opposition
what_it_is: Duties and Privileges of the Leader of the Opposition

sections.label: Leader of the Opposition duties
sections.summary: Mr Singh's duties and privileges as Leader of the Opposition remain the same as in the 14th Parliament, as set out in the 31 August 2020 Ministerial Statement.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: Mr Singh’s duties and privileges as the Leader of the Opposition in this 15th Parliament will remain the same as those in the 14th Parliament.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: Those were set out in my Ministerial Statement of 31 August 2020 when the office of the Leader of the Opposition was officially recognised and implemented.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The Leader of the Opposition will take the seat directly across the Prime Minister in this Chamber during Parliamentary proceedings.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The Leader of the Opposition will generally be given the right of first response among Members of Parliament (MPs) to ask the lead question of Ministers on policies, Bills and Motions in Parliament.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The Leader of the Opposition will have a longer speech time for debates than other backbenchers – 40 minutes as opposed to the usual 20 minutes.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The Leader of the Opposition will also be allocated an office in Parliament, staff support and resources, and his Parliamentary allowance will be double that of other MPs.

sections.label: Opposition role in 15th Parliament
sections.summary: Mr Singh will lead and organise the Opposition's Parliamentary business in the 15th Parliament, which has 99 elected Members.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The 15th Parliament of Singapore is our largest Parliament to date with 99 elected Members.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: As the Leader of the Opposition, Mr Singh will lead and organise the Opposition’s Parliamentary business in our largest Parliament to date.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: This includes leading the Opposition in: presenting alternative views in Parliamentary debates on policies, Bills and Motions; scrutinising the Government’s positions and actions in Parliament; and nominating opposition Members for appointment to the Standing Select Committees and other Select Committees of Parliament.
